region_scene_page.compact: Metalcore carries hardcore's impact and metal's riff discipline into 2000s and 2010s heavy radio, emo, and festival worlds.
region_scene_page.standard: Metalcore carries hardcore's impact and metal's riff discipline into 2000s and 2010s heavy radio, emo, and festival worlds. Killswitch Engage's The End of Heartache, Avenged Sevenfold's Bat Country, Trivium's Pull Harder on the Strings of Your Martyr, and Bullet for My Valentine's Tears Don't Fall give the scene its high-recognition landmarks.
region_scene_page.deep: Metalcore carries hardcore's impact and metal's riff discipline into 2000s and 2010s heavy radio, emo, and festival worlds. The distinct move is contrast: screamed pressure against clean melody, pit rhythm against chorus lift. Killswitch Engage's The End of Heartache, Avenged Sevenfold's Bat Country, Trivium's Pull Harder on the Strings of Your Martyr, and Bullet for My Valentine's Tears Don't Fall give the scene its high-recognition landmarks. From there, the examples move from quick recognition toward medium and deeper scene signals.
